name: growth-mulch
effect: Used on a patch of soil : Plant’s growth stages will each last 25% less time. Dries soil out more quickly.
shortEffect: Growing time of berries is reduced, but the soil dries out faster.

flavorTextEntries.text: A plant fertilizer spread on soft soil. It speeds up the growth of Berries. However, it also dries the soil faster.
